name: taskcut
description: Compacts the conversation at sub-task boundaries instead of at the context limit. The model calls close_task when a piece of work is finished; taskcut then replaces that work's transcript with the conclusion the model wrote, keeping the human turns verbatim and spending no summarizer call.

activation.title: Where taskcut runs
activation.description: "opt-in" (default): only in a repository whose root holds a .taskcut file, or a session where TASKCUT=1. "always": in every session this plugin is loaded in. TASKCUT=0 switches it off whatever this says.

floorPercent.title: Compact above this context fill
floorPercent.description: A compaction invalidates the prompt cache, so a cut is only worth making once the window has actually filled: the kept set is re-cached at full price, measured at 12k-15k tokens. Below this percentage a closed sub-task is recorded but the transcript is left alone. Set to 0 to cut at every boundary.

recentHumanTurns.title: Recent human turns kept verbatim
recentHumanTurns.description: Human turns are kept word for word, but they are unbounded on a long run. The turn that set the standing task is always kept; this is how many of the most recent ones are kept beside it.

ledgerVerbatim.title: Ledger entries kept verbatim
ledgerVerbatim.description: The ledger is the one thing a cut never shrinks. Past this many closed sub-tasks the oldest are folded into a single rolled-up entry by one small-model call.

foldModel.title: Model that folds the ledger
foldModel.description: Alias or full id, resolved the way a --model value is. Only used when the ledger grows past the verbatim limit.
